title_en: 'Mind-Blowingly Good': The Internet Reacts to Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6: Extended Look Reveal
summary_en: Rockstar's hugely-impressive first look at GTA 6 is being celebrated online, as today's Grand Theft Auto 6: Extended Look presentation has now debuted via Netflix.
body_en:
Rockstar's hugely-impressive first look at GTA 6 is being celebrated online, as today's Grand Theft Auto 6: Extended Look presentation has now debuted via Netflix.
Fans, streamers and game developers alike have heaped praise on the footage, with numerous comments calling out the game's highly-detailed character design and animation, as well as the sheer wealth of activities on display .
If you're still waiting for the footage to drop more widely beyond Netflix, we have guide to when the Extended Look will debut more widely in your timezone . Or scroll downwards, and take in some of the reactions to it now to whet your appetite:
GTA VI LOOKS INSANE pic.twitter.com/VV59nW4OmX
IShowSpeed couldn’t believe GTA 6 added streamers into the game pic.twitter.com/HDkPHoRLOH
What did I just watch? That world looked so lived in, I almost don't want to know how it was made.
Some incredible NPC behaviour 👏🏿 #GTAVI
Well as expected. The attention to detail in GTA 6 is staggering. The Floridian in me is pleased.
GTA 6 is so interesting because while it’s everything i’ve ever prayed it would be for the last decade, it’s also just a outrageous level up that my mind can’t comprehend
It’s those gameplay features. The breathing visuals. Everything that makes the world feel alive. To say it’s… pic.twitter.com/ReeA49DUwU
Thoughts on the gameplay: GTA 6 is going to be the greatest game of all time.
This is the most detailed, gorgeous open world ever created with gameplay that is far more involved, fun and polished than any other Rockstar game. They just showed the most alive, most dense, most… pic.twitter.com/AXrU7LgHmf
The animation quality and ambition in this GTAVI footage is mind-blowingly good. So hard to do that level of quality or even try that. Also both lead characters I’m feeling their vibe. I love Miami so seeing so many familiar locations was awesome.
The resemblance is uncanny… #gtavı pic.twitter.com/sYRvvrMTBl
Hey we got the full Netflix special on DVD if you wanna come over and watch it. pic.twitter.com/5mVjvzy7Hz
Developing...
For all of the biggest reveals from tonight's Extended Look, be sure to catch up with our GTA 6 reveal live blog , as well as our full preview coverage from IGN's own trip to see Grand Theft Auto 6 , exclusive interview with Rockstar , and 69 GTA 6 details we learned during our visit .
